out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED TO HANDWASHING SINK IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED TO SINK DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: OBSERVED HEAVY WHIPPING CREAM IN ONE-DOOR STANDING COOLER DATED WITH AN EXPIRATION OF MAY 26, 2026.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CDI: HEAVY WHIPPING CREAM DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: beet salad, cabbage salad, and various cooked foods are not date marked in the fridge
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC date marked cooked foods in the facility

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed medicines and Clorox wipes being stored above food contact surfaces
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. PIC moved medicines and Clorox wipes

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers of garlic and spices were observed reused for the storage of various spices such as sumac, pepper carrot salad, beets, jalapeño and garlic sauce
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC agreed to discontinue use of the single service containers

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: EHS observed current 2025 permit was not posted in a conspicuous location, EHS observed the facility before COO permit was posted, Formerly Taza Falafel, now Grub Palace
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. PIC ACQUIRED AND REPOSTED GRUB PALACE PERMIT.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: EHS OBSERVED RAW MARINATED CHICKEN IN THE 2 DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER BEING STORED OVER READY TO EAT SAUCES AND PICKLED VEGGIES IN SUCH A MANNER THAT IT COULD POTENTIALLY CONTAMINATE THE PICKLED VEGGIES AND READY TO EAT SAUCES.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc.PIC MOVED THE RAW MARINATED CHICKEN SO IT WAS BEING STORED UNDER READY TO EAT SAUCES AND PICKLED VEGGIE.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1 DOOR ON COUNTER COOLER HOLDING SAUCES AND PRE MADE BAKLAVA
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC REPLACED THERMOMETER IN COLD HOLDING UNIT

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: EHS OBSERVED THE IN CEILING VENTILATION IS MISSING THE MESH GRILL FOR THE VENT DUCT OVER THE THREE COMPARTMENT SINK
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC AGREED TO HAVE THE VENT MESH GRILL REPAIRED.
